evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any questions or concerns that you want to go over on this call today?" — asked before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer volunteers ramp/threshold/door-width access details and rep keeps digging ("How many boxes are you thinking?") until the customer runs out of detail ("I can't even think of anything else").
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if you sell everything and it takes us four hours, then you only pay for that" (beats-it-pay-less) + "I might estimate on the higher side just because of all the boxes" (window framing); no commit-to-rate line, no self-prep tip, no "does that feel fair" + silence.

top_strength: Excellent rapport and a well-personalized estimate anchor (explicitly widened for box volume and the extra drive time) plus full Stage 2 takeaway — both On-Time and Communication (day-before call, day-of on-the-way notice) land.
coaching_note: Close only got the explicit ask, not the rate-lock line — add "your rate locks when you book" before asking to get on the schedule, and work in the self-prep tip and a genuine "does that feel fair?" pause before closing.
